instruction: `is_palindrome` in `textutils/compare.py` does not ignore letter case, so mixed-case palindromes are reported as not palindromes. For input `RaceCar` it returns `False` instead of `True`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/compare.py b/textutils/compare.py
--- a/textutils/compare.py
+++ b/textutils/compare.py
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@
 
     ``"A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"`` -> True, ``"racecar"`` -> True.
     """
-    cleaned = strip_non_alnum(text)
+    cleaned = strip_non_alnum(text).lower()
     return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]
